title: PULSEmech Device Ledger Verification Report v0
description: Closed machine-readable output contract for the separately implemented PULSEmech Device Transition Ledger verifier. The report binds the exact .pulseledger carrier, verifier source, package members, contracts, observer identity, ledger chain, transition relations, checkpoint signature, package signature, claim boundary, and authority boundary. Verification does not constitute a device-security verdict, a physical-measurement claim, external validation, or release authority.
$comment: A successful report requires every declared check to pass. verified_with_declared_unavailability is a successful integrity and relation result; it preserves explicit observation gaps or unavailable initiating sources and must not be downgraded to failure or upgraded to causation. Rejected reports produced before exact carrier-byte admission may set carrier digests, carrier sizes and the carrier-derived verification_id to null; successful reports require all three identities to be concrete and independently reconstructed.
